about: DXVK 3.1.1's Clear rule (src/d3d9/d3d9_device.cpp:1894-2075) as literal cases, each worked by hand from DXVK's code: the regions D3D9DeviceEx::Clear clears (viewport, scissor, rectangles; clear_regions in host/d3d9gpu/d9g_clear.h) and, for each region, ClearImageView's result on an image of the given size (clear_image). Documentation/scripts/tests/test_s5_d3d9gpu.py runs every case through host/d3d9gpu's test_d3d9gpu --clear-cases, the same functions the device and the frame census use.

cases.name: full_viewport
cases.why: the boot's clears: the whole back buffer

cases.name: viewport_2560x1080
cases.why: the viewport larger than the back buffer (156 times in boot): the extent clamps to the image, a full clear

cases.name: scissor_off_ignores_rect
cases.why: the scissor rectangle counts only with SCISSORTESTENABLE

cases.name: scissor_moves_offset_not_extent
cases.why: offset = max(viewport, scissor) = (300, 200); extent = min(600, 900 - 300), min(400, 700 - 200): the viewport's width is not reduced by the moved offset, so DXVK clears to x 900, past the viewport's right edge at 700

cases.name: scissor_difference_wraps
cases.why: sc.right - offset.x = 256 - 600 wraps as unsigned, so the width stays 512; the offset 600 is past the 512-wide image, which is skipped

cases.name: shadow_pass_256x192
cases.why: Metal Harbor's shadow-map clear of 0,0 256x192 of a 512x512 target (scan/mh2.txt)

cases.name: shadow_pass_64x48
cases.why: Metal Harbor's 64x48 shadow-map clear

cases.name: first_rect_covers
cases.why: a first rectangle covering the region means no rectangles (Count = 0)

cases.name: first_rect_exact
cases.why: covering is <= and >=: the exact region counts

cases.name: rect_list
cases.why: each rectangle intersected with the region; the one outside it is dropped

cases.name: rect_cut_by_scissor
cases.why: the region is 640x360; the rectangle keeps 600..640 by 300..360

cases.name: count_with_null_rects
cases.why: Count with pRects NULL: DXVK sets Count = 0 and clears the region (d3d9_device.cpp:1932-1934), answering D3D_OK

cases.name: empty_viewport
cases.why: a zero extent clears nothing (d3d9_device.cpp:2048-2050)

cases.name: empty_scissor
cases.why: a scissor of zero width

cases.name: offset_past_image
cases.why: an offset at the image's edge skips the image (d3d9_device.cpp:1969-1970)

cases.name: past_edge
cases.why: DXVK clamps the extent (400 <= 1280), not offset plus extent: the region runs past the edge, which Vulkan does not define and the device does not implement

cases.name: rect_negative
cases.why: a rectangle starting before the region starts at the region

cases.name: smaller_image_full
cases.why: each image clamps the extent to itself: a 512x512 image bound beside a larger one is cleared whole

cases.name: scissor_negative_left
cases.why: max(0, -100) keeps the viewport's offset

cases.name: rect_before_region
cases.why: a rectangle wholly before the region is dropped, and nothing is cleared
